SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
This is a good opportunity, I should invite Kuroneko 
out somewhere.

I thought about my girlfriend, who I'd just started 
dating this summer.

She's my junior at school, close friends with Kirino 
and me, and an awkward chuunibyou at that...
A-Anyways!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Come to think of it, I haven't had a proper date 
with her yet.

It wouldn't be a bad idea to seize the moment to 
create fond summer memories with Kuroneko. With 
that in mind...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Since arranging a date by phone is kinda boring, I 
should go meet her in person!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Crap, this is really embarrassing...

Right, I haven't even made arrangements to meet! 
I-If I suddenly barged in on her, wouldn't I just be 
a bother...

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN
TEXT: ...What are you doing, Senpai?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Whoa!? K-Kuroneko? Why are you here...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: This is my house after all. Why wouldn't I be here?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
...Hinata was saying, Kousaka-kun was holding his 
head groaning about something in front of the 
house, so I came flying out...

Kuroneko's hand was gripping onto a first aid kit 
for some reason... Did she think I was injured?
I mean, just how loud was I groaning...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
So, what can I do for you? I was in the midst of 
mastering alchemy to retrieve some essence from 
my witch's cauldron.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah, were you in the middle of cooking? My bad.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ? What's the matter?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
N-Nothing at all. Anyway, is there an important 
matter I should know about?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Well, actually, since it is summer, why don't we go 
somewhere together?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Summer vacation's almost over, you know... I mean, 
we are dating, after all...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I-Indeed. I can... consider it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: R-Really? So is there somewhere you'd like to go?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Yes... I had something in mind. Would you like to 
accompany me?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Of course!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Okay, the day after tomorrow then. Is it okay if we 
meet at my house?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Got it.
--Thus, our date has been arranged.

Heh, just you wait and see. I will definitely create 
the best memories this summer!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It's hot...

Above me, blue sky and white clouds. Before me, 
the wide ocean. Kuroneko and I came to the beach 
nearby.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Seriously though, it's way too hot, isn't it?

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN
TEXT:
If you keep saying it's hot, don't you know it's going 
to get even hotter?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: D-Don't stare at me like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah, sorry.

Since we're at the beach, and it's summer... 
naturally, Kuroneko was in a swimsuit.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Good grief, it looks like it'll be a long wait before 
you awaken the dormant black beast within you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No need for something like that to wake up.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Still...

In order to avoid my gaze, Kuroneko was sitting on 
the ground grasping her knees.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...Do you have something to say?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Well, I'm just wondering when you're going to 
show me your swimsuit properly.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Ah, erm...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...Don't look at me with such dirty eyes.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Well, hey! Isn't it normal to be in a swimsuit while at 
the beach?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Honestly... I came here to collect shellfish, you know.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: There was no need for me to wear a swimsuit.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah, yeah...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...Do you wish to see it that badly?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Eh...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
I'm asking you if you really wish to see me in a 
swimsuit.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well, yeah...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I-I guess there's no helping it...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...It's not weird, is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No, you look really cute.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...R-Really...

Oh, don't we have a pretty good atmosphere going 
on right now?

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: Hey~ Ruri-nee! Kousaka-kun!

SPEAKER: SPK_TAMAKI
TEXT: Hey~

And with that, the sweet atmosphere ended 
instantly.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: What's wrong?

Kuroneko easily shifted gears from an embarrassed 
girlfriend to a dependent elder sister.

SPEAKER: SPK_TAMAKI
TEXT: Nee-sama, I've gathered a lot!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Oh my, you've done well, haven't you.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
Nihihi, at this rate, it's simply a matter of time 
before we collect all the shellfish on this beach.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Of course, that would never happen...

As I was saying that, I took a peek at the bucket 
Hinata-chan was holding, there were a decent 
amount of clams inside.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Oh-, that's quite a lot.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: Well, that's expected if you leave it to us!

SPEAKER: SPK_TAMAKI
TEXT: Has Onii-chan found anything?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well, about that...

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
Uwah, nothing at all?! Looks like you'll be going 
without lunch today, Kousaka-kun.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I spent a lot of time and effort to prepare it, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: If man will not work, he shall not eat.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Wait, wait! I'll show you what I'm really made of! 
Look forward to it!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Yes yes, I'm counting on you.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
Uwah, Kousaka-kun has fallen completely into 
Ruri-nee's hands, just by getting through to his 
stomach...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Leave me alone. Aren't you girls pretty much the 
same?

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: Well, that's just how it is~

SPEAKER: SPK_TAMAKI
TEXT: It's because Nee-sama's cooking is really delicious.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: Hey, more importantly~

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hm?

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
How's my swimsuit?! I bet Kousaka-kun's 
completely enchanted by my sexiness?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No, Kuroneko's swimsuit is definitely cuter.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
You're bragging about her! That's only because 
she's your girlfriend, right!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It's nothing like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Huh? What are you even saying?

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
Wait!? Haven't you considered buttering up to your 
lovely sister-in-law?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No no, not at all. It pales in comparison to Kuroneko...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Kukuku... This man's soul is fully in my grasp, down 
to the last shred.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
Guh, this lovey-dovey couple! Even though Ruri-nee 
has the same bust size as me...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What did you say...

Kuroneko and Hinata-chan have the same bust 
size? Wait, wait, wait, assuming Hinata-chan's are 
normal for her age, that means... eh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Fu, fufufu... I was wondering what you were going 
to say, to think they were such nonsense...

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
Nonsense? Oh no, you're so wrong! Since you won't 
show your swimsuit to your boyfriend, the reason 
has to be...

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: Ouch!? You really just hit me?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
I-It's because you were saying nothing but absurd 
things.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
Yeah? Then tell me why you're blushing so much! 
Well? Try saying it!

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: Hyaa!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Fu... kukuku... I'm sorry, Senpai. I have to excuse 
myself for a while...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: O-Okay...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Come now, Hinata. It seems like some rehabilitation 
is in order...

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: N-ooooooo--!

Just like that, Hinata-chan was taken to a distant 
place by Kuroneko... Farewell.

Like a calf loaded onto a wagon, Hinata-chan got 
dragged away by Kuroneko. Well, hang in there. I'll 
pray for you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Are you really okay with this?

SPEAKER: SPK_TAMAKI
TEXT: ? Is something wrong, Onii-chan?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
No, it's nothing. Let's fill up your bucket before they 
come back.

SPEAKER: SPK_TAMAKI
TEXT: Okay!

As I continued the shellfish gathering with 
Tamaki-chan, I faintly recalled the things that 
happened during the summer.
You know, a lot of things did happen...

Carrying the overworked and unconscious 
Kuroneko, hurrying to the school infirmary.

Helping out with her doujin, going to Kuroneko's 
house.

Which reminds me, that was also the first time I 
met Hinata-chan and Tamaki-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
This is a ritual to break the curse. And now I'll 
make a new one.
After that, Kuroneko and I became lovers.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
If only you were to call me "onee-sama" obediently, 
I would be able to say that phrase... what a pity.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: It's 'My Little Sister Can't Be This Cute'.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Oh yeah, I wonder if Kirino is still mad?

Kirino doesn't show it, but since she likes Kuroneko 
so much, she'll probably get over it.

That aside, the most important thing now concerns 
me and Kuroneko.

...Even though we've gone through so much trouble 
to become a couple, things haven't progressed at 
all.

Well, this is my first time dating a girl, I should be 
ecstatic. However...
Even now, we still don't even hold hands at all...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Kuroneko's not done changing yet?

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: Now now, girls do take time to change, you know?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: But a certain someone came out pretty fast, huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
Kousaka-kun, don't you have any consideration for a 
maiden?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hey. Putting that aside, I have a question to ask.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: That aside?! W-Well, whatever. Ask away?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
It's nothing serious, but when did Kuroneko... you 
know... start acting like that? Like her outfit and 
such?

SPEAKER: SPK_TAMAKI
TEXT:
Nee-sama's spiritual awakening? That happened 
recently.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
...A few years ago, I think. But, why this out of the 
blue?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well, um...

Just like seeing her in a swimsuit, I also want to see 
her dressed up normally... stuff like that.
I mean, Gothic Lolita-style Kuroneko is cute too!

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
Ah, so you're thinking about what happens after the 
wedding?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Pfft?! What are you saying, all of a sudden!

Well, naturally, I'm also concerned about that. If 
there's no development and Kuroneko's chuunibyou 
takes a turn for the worse...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
I am the Angel of Vengeance "Yamineko"... an 
abominable existence whose heart has been 
devoured by darkness.
On top of that, if she gets tempted by Fate-san...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
In order to win the short story award, I shall be 
going out to gather material.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Where are you going?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...A pachinko parlor.

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT: Let us be off! Kuroneko-san!
...Things might get troublesome.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: What's wrong, Kousaka-kun? You don't look so good.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: A-Ah, it's nothing.

Anyway, in order to avoid the worst possible 
outcome, I should make my move.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Sorry for the wait... What's wrong?
